query: Write the pull request description for a configuration refactor. The output is unchanged, and I have matching test logs rather than a performance improvement. Help reviewers understand the evidence.
Improve this PR body without replacing our required template headings or the machine-readable candidate comment. It needs a clearer explanation of what changed.
Prepare the combined pull request summary for two integrated tickets. Only the coordinator will publish; describe the actual candidate and leave CI pending.
The repair is committed and reviewed. Draft the update comment on the existing pull request, keeping its robot marker and exact base/head/target fields.
Help me explain merge risk in a PR that starts sending customer emails. Reverting the code cannot unsend them; what recovery conditions should the description disclose?
Our pull request description shows a planned pytest command as evidence. We have no baseline output or screenshot. Rewrite that section so it is honest about the gaps.
Draft a branch-only implementation handoff's PR presentation for the publisher. The evidence exists at a fixed commit, but I have no permission to push or post anything.
The reviewer can't tell which consumers and retained data this change affects. Improve the existing pull request explanation using our configured domain vocabulary.
This change moves files without changing behavior. Help me decide whether a shallow tree or small diff would clarify the pull request description; don't add a ceremonial diagram.
The PR text says the migration is a two-way door, but restoring deleted records requires a backup we haven't verified. Help describe the recovery limits accurately.
Run a standards review on the diff since commit abc123. Produce cited blocking and advisory findings only; do not prepare or edit the PR description.
Compare this branch's implementation against ticket 17 and report missing requirements. I want a spec review, not presentation or publication.
Resolve the stopped merge conflict in parser.py after investigating both branch intents. Preserve my untracked files; the commit message can wait.
Use tea to read PR42's current head, target and mergeability. I need exact forge facts, not help writing its body or comment.
The regression test fails on the pagination boundary. Diagnose the bug and add a permanent failing test before fixing it; no PR text is requested.
Explain whether a customer-email operation can safely retry after a timeout. Design the idempotency boundary, not a pull request summary.
Capture a real screenshot of the local dashboard and inspect console errors. Don't invent an image; this is browser reproduction, not PR preparation.
Write a release announcement for customers about the new export feature. There is no pull request or review handoff involved.
Create an ADR deciding whether to keep the custom domain glossary filename. Do not rename files or write a PR description yet.
Audit the repository for pass-through wrappers and speculative abstractions. Return ranked cut candidates, not an explanation of a proposed pull request.
